pages.title: Our story | NKT
pages.text: Our story | NKT Contact Career Investors Media Regional Sites Regional Sites Germany Czechia Denmark Poland Sweden Finland Norway North America UK & Ireland Products Solutions & markets References Downloads News & events About us Sustainability Search Suggested Pages High-voltage cables Medium-voltage cables Cable Services Low-voltage cables Menu Products Solutions & markets References Downloads News & events About us Sustainability Contact Career Investors Media Regional Sites Search Suggested Pages High-voltage cables Medium-voltage cables Cable Services Low-voltage cables Regional Sites Germany Czechia Denmark Poland Sweden Finland Norway North America UK & Ireland Power to life since 1891 A story of constant innovation About us Our story Key milestones since 1891 2022 Fire-resistant cables Acquisition of Ventcroft in the United Kingdom to continue expansion of Applications product portfolio. 2020 NKT commits to net-zero emissions As the first major power cable manufacturer NKT officially signs up for the Science Based Target initiative to become a net-zero emissions company. Begins running all production sites on green electricity. 2020 NKT wins the German Corridor projects The 525 kV cable system is a key element in developing a DC grid that can use renewable energy generation more efficiently. NKT is awarded major orders for the German Corridor projects, which are key enablers of the green transition of Germany. 2017 Acquisition of factory in Karlskrona With the acquisition of ABB HV Cables in Sweden, NKT increased capacity of HV cable production and offshore cable-laying capabilities with the deployment of the customer-made vessel, NKT Victoria. 2013 We acquire Ericsson’s cable operations Acquisition of Ericsson power cable operations in Sweden to increase our Applications product portfolio. 2010 New state-of-the-art plant Opening the new state-of-the-art production plant in Cologne, Germany focused on high-voltage cables. 2001 Development of a superconducting cable NKT became the first company to develop a superconducting cable. 1995 PVC and halogen-free cables and cords Introduction of a new range of PVC and halogen-free cables and cords that improved environmental and safety elements. 1954 World´s first HVDC MI offshore cable NKT launches the first HVDC MI submarine cable. connecting Gotland with the Swedish mainland. 1891 Our foundation The Dane Hans Peter Prior founded Nordiske Kabel- og Traadfabriker A/S. Code of Conduct Integrity and honesty make up the foundation of trust. Exciting career opportunities at NKT We strongly believe our people are the key to success.
